name: Turgor
source:
Who are you?
Why do you feel this way?
What is happening to the people around you?

Your attempts to escape The Greenhouse just may be futile.

[From [url=https://gamewill.itch.io/turgor] itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你是谁？
为什么会有这种感觉？
周围的人发生了什么？

你试图逃离温室，但也许一切都是徒劳。

（来源：[url=https://gamewill.itch.io/turgor]itch.io[/url]）
